Senior Go-To-Market & User Insights Lead (Remote)

Location: Flexible, preferably Larger World

Reports to: Director of Strategic Partnerships

Description:

Meedan seeks a strategic and entrepreneurial Senior Go-To-Market & User Insights Lead to drive adoption, growth, and impact for our global technology products in the Larger World. The successful candidate will bridge go-to-market strategy, user research, and product positioning to ensure our tools are embraced by independent media and civil society organizations across North Africa/Western Asia, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America/Caribbean. This is a hands‑on role where you’ll combine deep listening to communities with sharp product storytelling and execution, building strategies that accelerate uptake and scale.

We are a global not‑for‑profit that helps independent media and civil society organizations exchange critical information with communities through AI‑powered interactions on messaging apps. We design programs that help improve the exchange of quality information in communities. Our work has won multiple awards for collaborative project design around the world. Our software allows journalists and other information leaders to communicate directly with their audiences on closed messaging apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, and Viber.

As our Senior Go-To-Market & User Insights Lead , you will be responsible for developing adoption strategies, conducting research to understand target users and partners, shaping product positioning, and collaborating with internal teams to ensure launches land with impact. You’ll partner with product, program, communication, and research teams to define market entry strategies (including pricing), onboard new partners, and craft the stories and frameworks that show how our technology transforms information exchange.

Required Experience and Qualifications

  • 5–7 years of experience in go-to-market, product marketing, or product strategy roles.
  • Demonstrated success in developing and executing GTM strategies for new products or features.
  • Experience combining user research and product insights to shape positioning and messaging.

Preferred but not required

  • Experience designing for multilingual communities in diverse global geographies.
  • Experience in journalism, civic tech, human rights, or nonprofit sectors.
  • Familiarity with human rights or user rights-based frameworks for technology development preferred.
  • Strong communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to adapt for technical, funder, and community audiences.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to lead initiatives from concept to execution in a resource‑constrained environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead GTM planning for new features and products, from positioning to launch to post‑launch adoption.
  • Define value propositions and messaging frameworks that resonate with journalists, civil society organizations, and the communities they serve.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and program leads to ensure product readiness and impact.
  • Develop onboarding strategies and resources for partners adopting Meedan’s tools.
  • Build playbooks and repeatable processes for scaling adoption across regions.

User & Market Insights

  • Conduct research to deeply understand target users, their pain points, and market opportunities.
  • Map user journeys and partner workflows to identify barriers to adoption and design solutions.
  • Gather and analyze feedback from pilot deployments and iterate GTM strategies accordingly.
  • Track usage, adoption metrics, and market trends to inform roadmap and program direction.

Cross‑functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with program staff to tailor GTM strategies for local contexts and languages.
  • Collaborate with research team on user testing methodologies and incorporating user rights considerations in design.
  • Work closely with communications to align product launches with broader storytelling and media strategies.
  • Work with the fundraising team to equip funder conversations with strong product narratives and success metrics.

About Meedan

Meedan is a nonprofit focused on building digital tools and community‑led programs that enhance the accessibility, reliability, and distribution of information — when and where people need it most. We codesign open‑source tools and programs, enabling communities — especially those that have been historically underserved — to access the information they need to organize and mobilize. We also strive to make online ecosystems safer, more inclusive, and more equitable, so that existing pathways for content production and distribution can better serve the needs of all communities, regardless of their location, language, or income.

description:
Overview

Staff Application Security Engineer at LEDN. Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping Bitcoin holders and supporting the future of wealth. LEDN offers lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries. LEDN values integrity, owning responsibilities, progress, and empathy, and aims to democratize access to the global economy through its products and services.

Responsibilities

  • Application Security: Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams. Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services. Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD. Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features. Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Authentication & Identity: Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications. Enhance Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens). Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows. Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves): Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads. Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs. Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments. Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Additional Security Domains: Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management. Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring). Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks. Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review. Understanding of software supply chain. Deep understanding of Linux internals. Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report. Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture & Fit

  • We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
  • The ideal candidate will be adaptable, resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment. Have a builder's mindset, enjoy creating, iterating, and scaling IS practices. Be a collaborative partner who can influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity. Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts. Experience working in a remote environment.

A Taste Of What We Provide

Help Us Build the Future of Outdoor Services

  • Collaborate on designing and implementing system architecture, technical strategy, and engineering standards.

  • Mentor engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and hands-on guidance.

  • Evaluate and implement new tools, frameworks, and best practices to continuously improve our platform.
  • Enhance observability, performance, scalability, and security throughout our system.
  • Share knowledge and insights to foster team growth and improvement.

What We’re Looking For

  • We’re looking for someone who is:
    • Experienced:
      • A principal engineer, lead full-stack engineer, or someone with relevant experience in similar roles.

    • Customer-Centric:
      • Passionate about clean code and building customer-driven solutions with a focus on quality and reliability.

All team members at LawnStater are expected to embody our core values which are: Be data-driven, Get shit done, People are critical, Challenge the status quo, Be scrappy, and Be the Customer.

title: Staff Application Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Staff Application Security Engineer role at LEDN .

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms.

Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. The core values are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Ledn aims to change the world for the better by building, innovating and revolutionizing financial services. Join us as we build secure, innovative solutions.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments.

This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Responsibilities

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads using AWS Nitro Enclaves.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs; migrate high-value operations into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in penetration test reports.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We’re looking for a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will:
    • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
    • Have a builder's mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
    • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
    • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
    • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • As one of the world's leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • Competitive PTO package and ownership in the company through shared equity.
  • Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career with purpose and a culture that removes barriers so you love what you do.
  • We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity. For accommodation requests during recruitment, please email the Ledn team confidentially.

Ledn Working Environment: We are a remote-first, globally distributed team spanning North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe.

Please note: due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response, and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees related to unsolicited resumes.

description:
VW. Two letters. Endless opportunities. A bright future.

Innovation. Sophistication. Optimization. This is our Passion.

Worldwide, the Volkswagen Group has a long tradition of dramatic innovations. The Volkswagen Group, with its headquarters in Wolfsburg, is one of the world’s leading automobile manufacturers and the largest carmaker in Europe. The Group comprises twelve brands from seven European countries: Volkswagen Passenger Cars, Audi, SEAT, ŠKODA, Bentley, Bugatti, Lamborghini, Porsche, Ducati, Volkswagen Commercial Vehicles, Scania and MAN. Here in the US, we are blending German engineering with American ingenuity.

At the Innovation & Engineering Center California (IECC), we represent the Volkswagen Group in applied research and development. Located in the heart of Silicon Valley, we create bold new ideas for the Volkswagen, Audi, Bentley, Lamborghini, Bugatti and Porsche brands. We’re a team of engineers, designers, scientists, and psychologists looking to develop innovations for future generations of cars, and to transfer technologies from many industries and research institutions into the automotive domain. Our mission is to drive change which means we are not only impacting one of the world’s largest car makers, but also the lives of millions of people. Are you ready to join us?

Senior Virtual Test Engineer (Unable to consider OPT or CPT Candidates)

Role Summary

  • The Virtual Test Engineer will own the end‑to‑end test engineering for virtual ECUs — from V‑ECU creation (AUTOSAR Classic/Adaptive) and restbus/environment modeling, to deterministic simulation, fault injection, conformance, diagnostics/flash, and scalable CI execution. You will build and operate a virtual test platform that exercises production software stacks (communication, diagnostics, safety/security, OTA readiness) with measurable coverage and release‑grade performance. You partner with software, systems, safety, cybersecurity, HIL, and OTA teams to ensure the virtual pipeline finds defects earlier than HIL/vehicle, at fleet scale.
  • The position will be a member of the worldwide connectivity technical team and interfaces with multiple stakeholders of VW Group’s technical team members. This position investigates and develops new architectures for connected systems targeted to the US market.

Role Responsibilities

Operational Management - (35%)

  • Ownership of Virtual Test topics in NAR markets
  • Own the relationship with network operator, contract manufacturer, platform provider and lead strategic discussions and technical negotiations.
  • Serve as technical authority for V‑ECU testing; mentor engineers in XiL best practices, determinism, and modeling trade‑offs.
  • Drive supplier alignment (Tier‑1/2) for virtual deliverables (V‑ECU packages, ARXML/ODX/OTX, service catalogs, security plugins).
  • Conduct design/test reviews, DFMEA/FMEA, and lead 8D on defects discovered in SIL with crisp reproduction artifacts.

V ‑ ECU Build & Simulation Architecture – (35%)

  • Define the V‑ECU generation strategy for AUTOSAR Classic (RTE + BSW abstraction, virtual MCAL stubs) and Adaptive (POSIX targets, ara::com SOME/IP bindings), including OS abstraction, timers, time‑warp, and determinism controls.
  • Select and integrate V‑ECU platforms (e.g., dSPACE VEOS/SystemDesk, Vector vVIRTUALtarget/CANoe4SW Server, ETAS COSYM/ASCET, AVL VIRTUAL TESTBED, Wind River Simics, Imperas/OVPsim, QEMU/Renode‑based flows) and manage tool qualification where applicable.
  • Establish co‑simulation topologies: MIL/Plant models (Simulink/Modelica/FMU/FMI), bus/network simulators, and virtualization of sensors/actuators with IO semantics and timing fidelity.

Communication, Diagnostics & Flashing in SIL – (10%)

  • Model and validate Automotive Ethernet stacks: SOME/IP & SOME/IP‑SD, DoIP, AVB/TSN where applicable; simulate VLAN/QoS and congestion scenarios.
  • Exercise CAN/CAN‑FD, LIN, FlexRay via restbus simulations; verify UDS services, ISO‑TP segmentation and XCP/CCP measurement/calibration flows.
  • Implement DoIP‑routed UDS flashing in SIL with eligibility/state checks, A/B or recovery slots, anti‑rollback, and bootloader handshake emulation (timings, NRCs).

Virtual Environment & Restbus Modeling – (10%)

  • Develop restbus models for gateways, sensors, actuators, and peer ECUs using Vector CANoe/CAPL (incl. CANoe4SW Server), Python, and co‑simulation bridges.
  • Build service catalogs and SOME/IP service mocks, including late‑joiner/re‑announce behaviors and instance collision tests; emulate SecOC/E2E protections.
  • Create plant models (Simulink/Modelica, FMU/FMI) for closed‑loop testing of control functions; parameterize with production DBC/ARXML/LDF.

Robustness, Fault Injection & Fuzzing – (5%)

  • Execute fault campaigns: bus saturation, frame loss/reordering, clock drift, time sync perturbations (gPTP), power cycles/brown‑outs (virt), memory pressure, and network fuzzing (UDS/DoIP/SOME/IP).
  • Apply protocol fuzzing (boofuzz, Scapy, Peach, AFL++ harnesses), mutation testing, and error seeding to validate diagnostic/communication hardening.
  • Model electrical transients (ISO 7637‑2, load dump) effects at the software boundary and verify recovery logic within the V‑ECU.

CI – at – Scale & Test Data Ops – (5%)

  • Architect headless SIL farms (Docker/K8s runners, ephemerial test environments) executing parallel suites (thousands of SIL test‑cases per commit/nightly).
  • Integrate CI/CD (Jenkins/GitLab/Azure DevOps), artifact management (SBOM: SPDX/CycloneDX), test results (JUnit/Allure), and flaky test quarantine + triage dashboards.

title: Mobile Engineering Manager
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Mobile Engineering Manager role at Onfleet .

About Onfleet: Onfleet’s mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully. Our product includes intuitive smartphone apps for drivers, a modern web dashboard for logistics teams, and automatic notifications and real-time tracking for recipients. Onfleet powers millions of deliveries every week for thousands of businesses globally across industries such as grocery, prepared meals, pharmacy, flowers, and furniture.

What You’ll Do

You’ll lead and contribute to a high-performance engineering culture where transparency, feedback, and data-driven insights guide coaching, process improvements, and experimentation with tools to enable the team’s success and growth. You’ll lead a cross-functional product team focused on delivering resilient, performant, and maintainable systems that scale, particularly across iOS and Android ecosystems. You’ll foster an environment where engineers thrive, coaching for growth, driving clear execution, and maintaining velocity and quality. You delegate effectively, build clarity and trust, and guide people through opportunities and challenges.

  • Lead a high-performing engineering team focused on shipping impactful features in a startup environment.
  • Collaborate with product and design on roadmap execution and trade-offs.
  • Provide technical guidance in discussions around architecture, system design, and mobile development.
  • Mentor engineers, foster professional growth, and promote psychological safety.
  • Drive agile practices, remove team pain points, reduce technical debt, and continuously improve delivery efficiency.
  • Demonstrate a proactive, lean mindset, identifying bottlenecks and improvement areas in both process and technology, using coaching and agile leadership to enable continuous improvement.

What You’ll Bring To The Team

You bring a self-motivated, highly engaged, resourceful, driven, and passionate leadership style focused on delivering results by empowering others and removing blockers, rather than being the critical path yourself.

  • 5+ years of hands-on mobile development experience (iOS, Android, or both), building and delivering production apps with solid knowledge of mobile architecture, clean code, testing, and refactoring.
  • 3+ years of engineering management experience leading agile software teams.
  • Proven ability to balance execution speed, quality, and team health.
  • Excellent communication and decision-making skills, able to mediate and guide technical debates effectively.
  • Deep experience with agile software development, ideally including Scrum leadership or equivalent experience.
  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.
  • A proven track record of eliminating waste, whether in processes, meetings, or practices, while coaching low performers or making tough decisions to sustain a high-performing team.
  • You create a motivated, high-trust team environment, balancing compassion with accountability to achieve outstanding results.
  • Skilled in team development, including goal setting, effective delegation, coaching through challenges, and giving honest, respectful feedback. You act early when things aren’t working, supporting individuals and protecting the team.
  • Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience from multiple roles within an agile team.
  • Technical leadership experience with coaching individuals and teams in writing testable code and refactoring.
  • Demonstrates a deep understanding of mobile security best practices, including data encryption, user authentication, device firewalls and security software.
  • Experience with mobile Continuous Integration, shift-left quality validation, and developer-owned quality practices, with a willingness to mentor and share that knowledge.

How We Lead At Onfleet

We value leaders who empower their teams, coach through challenges, and stay out of the critical path. Engineering managers are facilitators of clarity, not command-and-control operators. We expect our managers to lead with trust, emotional intelligence, and a strong sense of ownership for outcomes. Execution is essential, but it’s achieved through delegation, support, and shared accountability, not by being the most active contributor.

Location & Workplace

  • We are headquartered in San Francisco, but we are seeking candidates from Canada and Latin America for this remote-first position.
  • Onfleet offers flexible work arrangements. You can work from home or anywhere with a reliable internet connection.
  • The team works core hours within East Coast Time (EDT); ability to work within these hours is required.

Please note that compensation and benefits may vary by location in accordance with local market standards and legal requirements.

Compensation & Location Transparency

Onfleet offers competitive compensation adjusted based on location and experience. For candidates located in Canada, the salary range is $120,000 to $160,000 USD annually. Compensation for candidates based in Latin America will be determined based on local market benchmarks and cost of living. We may use automated tools or AI-assisted systems to support resume screening and candidate evaluation. All final hiring decisions are made by real humans. By applying, you acknowledge that such tools may be used in the early stages of the hiring process.

Equal Opportunity

Onfleet is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity in the workplace and are committed to candidates who can bring diverse perspectives and experience. We do not make hiring decisions based on race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by law. We highly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply; qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered.

title: Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn\'s suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

About The Role

Application Security:

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.

Authentication & Identity

  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.

Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves)

  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.

Additional Security Domains

  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice To Haves

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will

  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.

A Taste Of What We Provide

  • As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company.
  • Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.
  • We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job.
  • We remove barriers so you love what you do.
  • We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.
  • You may reach out to the Ledn team by accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.
  • Ledn Working Environment: Our Ledn team is truly global in nature with our people spanning across North America, Latin America, South Africa and Europe. We are a remote first environment.

Please note, due to the high volume of applications, only those applicants that qualify will be contacted. As part of our selection process, shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role.

No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão: Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações web utilizando JavaScript/TypeScript e frameworks modernos como React e Next.Js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dados com bancos relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade. Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, como Azure, GCP e AWS. Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar: transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos. Definir arquitetura de software e padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas de DevOps, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes).Mentorar desenvolvedores de diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração. Contribuir estrategicamente para decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.O que nós estamos procurando;
Formação: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata. Experiência solida (+5 anos): em desenvolvimento web com React, Next.Js, JavaScript e TypeScript. Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance. Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade.Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD, uso de Docker, Kubernetes e ferramentas de integração contínua.Visão arquitetural e capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas. Inglês fluente (para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).O que oferecemos;
VR/VT Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!) Gympass Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!) Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!) Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção) Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;
Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender Cultura: junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

Os nossos sistemas demonstram uma contribuição essencial em aplicações como tinta em pó e enriquecimento protéico, bem como na produção de materiais de alta performance para sistemas de armazenamento de energia em baterias. Brazilian accounting (local standards), taxes (ICMS, PIS/COFINS, IRPJ/CSLL), accounting reconciliations, tax compliance, reporting to the Federal Revenue Service.  Advanced proficiency in Excel  Desirable use of Odoo  Solid knowledge of Brazilian tax and accounting legislation: IRPJ, CSLL, ICMS, ISS, PIS/COFINS  Brazilian accounting standards (CPCs), IFRS, internal accounting closing and reconciliation procedures  Active registration with the CRC (Regional Accounting Council); IFRS course or tax MBA desirable. title: Desenvolvedor de back end node.js
description: Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Node.js- Sênior. Você será uma peça chave no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, garantindo qualidade e eficiência, além de colaborar com a equipe na definição de boas práticas de desenvolvimento. Responsabilidades:  Desenvolver e manter aplicações back-end em Node.js, seguindo boas práticas de arquitetura e padrões de projeto.  Criar, documentar e integrar APIs RESTful de alta performance utilizando Type Script e Express.  Projetar e otimizar modelagem de dados em bancos relacionais (My SQL, Postgre SQL) e/ou No SQL (Mongo DB), garantindo queries performáticas e escalabilidade.  Utilizar ORMs como Type ORM, Sequelize ou Prisma para manipulação eficiente do banco de dados.  Versionar código com Git, adotando workflows (Git Flow, pull requests, code reviews) e boas práticas de controle de versão.  Trabalhar com Docker e docker-compose para criar ambientes de desenvolvimento e produção consistentes e reproduzíveis.  Garantir qualidade de código por meio de testes automatizados (unitários e de integração) usando Jest, Mocha ou similares.  Implementar mecanismos de cache (Redis, Memcached) e filas de mensagens (Rabbit MQ, AWS SQS/SNS, Kafka) para melhorar performance e escalabilidade.  Monitorar e depurar aplicações em produção utilizando ferramentas como Node Profiler, Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus.  Implementar pipelines de CI/CD (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Jenkins) para deploy automatizado em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou Kubernetes.  Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (front-end, Dev Ops, QA) em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban), participando de planning, daily e retrospectivas.   Resquisitos:  Experiência sólida com Node.js e Type Script, aplicando padrões de projeto (Factory, Repository, Dependency Injection) e estruturação modular (Clean Architecture, DDD).  Uso de Express (ou Nest JS/Koa) para construção de APIs, dominando rotas, middlewares, tratamento de erros e validação de payload (class-validator, Joi, Celebrate).  Gerenciamento de pacotes com npm ou yarn, versionamento semântico (semver) e controle de dependências.  Testes Automatizados: domínio de frameworks como Jest ou Mocha + Chai, testes de integração (supertest) e uso de mocks/fakes.  Escalabilidade e Desempenho: experiência em cache (Redis), filas de mensagens (Rabbit MQ, Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS) e otimizações de consultas em bancos relacionais (índices, partições).  Performance e Debugging: uso de ferramentas como Node Profiler, Clinic.js, monitoramento com Datadog, New Relic ou Prometheus/Grafana.  Integração Contínua e Deploy: prática com CI/CD (Git Hub Actions, Git Lab CI, Jenkins) e deploy em AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3) ou ambientes Kubernetes.  Docker Avançado: criação de imagens otimizadas, multi-stage builds e configuração de docker-compose para desenvolvimento e produção.  Banco de Dados Relacional Avançado: My SQL ou Postgre SQL (índices, query profiling, replicação, particionamento).  APIs Performáticas e Seguras: experiência com Graph QL (Apollo Server), API Gateway, autenticação/autorização via OAuth2, JWT e versionamento de APIs.  Git Profundo: workflows Git Flow, rebase vs merge, cherry-pick e estratégias de branching para times grandes.   Habilidades:  Conhecimento em PHP (Laravel, Code Igniter, Symfony): será considerado um diferencial entender boas práticas de desenvolvimento back-end em PHP e migrar/integrações pontuais.  Experiência com React (ou Next.js): habilidade para colaborar com o front-end em aplicações isomórficas ou SPA, integrando APIs e estados globais (Redux, Context API).  Frameworks Node.js avançados: Nest JS (dependency injection, modules, providers), Koa ou Fastify para cenários de alta concorrência.  Infraestrutura como Código (Ia C): conhecimento em Terraform ou Cloud Formation para provisionamento de ambientes AWS.  Monitoramento e Observabilidade: uso de ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana), Loki/Grafana, Open Telemetry para logs estruturados e métricas customizadas.  Event-Driven Architecture: trabalho com Kafka, Rabbit MQ, AWS SNS/SQS, Web Sockets (Socket.io) e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.  Microservices: experiência em decomposição de sistemas monolíticos, deploy independente de serviços, comunicação via mensageria e API Gateway.  Segurança: implementação de práticas OWASP (mitigação de SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF), configuração de WAF (Cloudflare, AWS WAF) e auditoria de código.  Serverless: desenvolvimento e deploy de funções AWS Lambda em Node.js/Type Script, integração com Dynamo DB, S3 e triggers (SQS, API Gateway). title: Human resources manager
description: JOB OVERVIEW:  The Human Resources Manager plays a pivotal role in partnering with leadership to strategically coordinate the full employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition and onboarding to fostering continuous faculty and staff development. This role is crucial in ensuring successful integration into EAC's unique school culture and actively championing school-wide well-being initiatives.  ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:  Talent Development & Retention  Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies and leadership development frameworks.  Maintains an accurate database of professional development experiences to inform future planning and ensure equitable allocation of resources.  Develops and implements career progression frameworks and provides individualized guidance in career development.  Proactively identifies and organizes relevant professional development opportunities (e.g., workshops, speakers, Ed Camps).  Attracting & Retaining Talent  Manages the advertisement of positions and ensures the revision of job descriptions, interview questions, and tracking the overall hiring process, in collaboration with hiring managers.  Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants, reviews resumes, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, checks background on applicants, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested.  Assists the Director of Finance and Administration in conducting compensation benchmarking and analysis, and utilizes systems to collect and analyze data on staff development, evaluation, retention, and attrition.  Organizes an overall calendar and individual events which recognize and celebrate the commitment of faculty & staff to EAC, fostering a positive and appreciative work environment.  Conducts interviews with faculty & staff as part of talent assessment and retention efforts.  Supporting performance reviews, tracking goal progress.  Actively sources and solicits qualified applicants from diverse backgrounds, reviews resumes with an equity lens, conducts initial and subsequent interviews, and makes recommendations to hiring managers, as requested, promoting a diverse candidate pool.  Supporting a Positive & Ethical Culture  Administers employment contracts and oversees the comprehensive onboarding process for all new staff, including a schedule of activities, and facilitates training in child protection and data protection.  Provides comprehensive support and resources to foreign hire staff as they settle into life in Campinas and at EAC.  Plans and implements outings for staff to support inclusion and celebration of the local culture of Campinas.  Collaborates with school Leadership to monitor and administer professional development programs, ensuring alignment with local and international best practices in areas such as evidence-based instructional strategies, leadership development frameworks, and DEIJ best practices.  Compliance and Child Protection  Collaborates with outsourced providers to ensure effective monitoring of EAC's complaint channel, facilitating appropriate incident reporting, including CIPA compliance.  Develops and delivers appropriate compliance training to staff and ensures the fully compliance with HR related laws  Establishes and oversees a robust school-wide system for mandatory child protection training for all EAC staff and third-party providers (liaising with counseling staff and Leadership).  Stays abreast of compliance-related laws and best practices in human resources, both nationally and internationally.  Proactively proposes and implements policy and procedure enhancements that support ethical behavior at EAC.  Develops and implements safer hiring protocols, including enhanced interview processes and comprehensive background, social media, and reference checks.  Wellbeing  Recommends a comprehensive yearly plan, in line with the school's strategic direction, articulating meaningful developments in all aspects of staff wellness.  Conducts research and benchmarking exercises to ensure EAC's approach to staff wellness incorporates new ideas and initiatives.  Establishes mechanisms for regular staff feedback on wellness initiatives, utilizing data to inform continuous improvement.  Collaborates with Leadership to research and recommend new benefits for inclusion in EAC's approach to staff wellness.  Health (physical and mental/emotional) Develops, promotes, and publishes a comprehensive yearly plan of offerings and events at EAC that support the health and wellbeing of all faculty & staff.  Develops and promotes wellbeing activities for faculty & staff, making use of local resources such as guest speakers and trainers.  Acts as a primary resource, providing advice and guidance to staff on personal wellbeing, and sharing awareness of internal and external resources.  Serves as an internal consultant for faculty and staff on personal matters, such as stress management and relationships, offering evidence-based strategies and resources to support mental health and wellbeing and foster coping mechanisms.  Other duties, as assigned.  POSITION REQUIREMENTS  BA in Human Resources, Psychology, or related field 5+ years of experience  HR policies, procedures, and best practices  Labor laws, employment regulations, and compliance (including CIPA) HR Information Systems (HRIS) Full recruitment and onboarding lifecycle  Compensation, benefits, and benchmarking  Professional development and training frameworks  Child protection and safeguarding protocols  Cultural competence and sensitivity.  Languages level requirement: B2 in English and C1 or above in Portuguese  Other Skills (Desirable):  Excellent communication (verbal and written) Strong organizational and time management abilities  High attention to detail  Problem-solving and conflict resolution  Interpersonal skills and empathy  Confidentiality and discretion  Data analysis  Adaptability and proactivity  Cultural awareness and sensitivity  Ability to foster an inclusive and equitable workplace culture.  Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children. We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct. At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.  EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Preschool teaching assistant (maternity cover)
description: JOB OVERVIEW:  The Teaching Assistant at EAC is dedicated to the school’s mission, vision, and core values, demonstrating respect for diverse cultures and learners. Teaching Assistants (TAs) play an essential role in supporting high-quality, inquiry-based international education within the Montessori and IB Primary Years Programme (PYP). Assigned to one classroom or one subject area for the school year, Teaching Assistants collaborate closely with the Specialist, Homeroom, and/or Brazilian Studies teacher to support student learning, provide individualized assistance, and foster an environment of care and belonging.  Teaching Assistants contribute to planning, instruction, assessment, and supervision, ensuring students are safe, engaged, and supported academically, socially, and emotionally. As active members of the Professional Learning Community, they participate in professional development and continuous reflection to enhance their effectiveness in supporting student growth.  ORGANIZATIONAL RESULTS:  Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and caring learning environment aligned with EAC’s mission and values.  Support the effective delivery of the school curriculum and programs by reinforcing learning and differentiated instruction.  Foster student well-being, independence, and positive relationships within the classroom and broader school community.  Model professionalism, collaboration, and ethical conduct in alignment with school policies and expectations.  CORE RESPONSIBILITIES:  Instructional Support and Student Learning  Collaborate with the classroom teacher to plan and deliver structured learning experiences for the whole class, small groups, and individual students.  Support students in understanding and reinforcing concepts introduced by the teacher, promoting independence and confidence in learning.  Prepare and organize resources, adapting materials and strategies to meet diverse student needs and cultural backgrounds.  Assist in providing formative feedback and collecting academic and behavioral data as directed by the teacher.  Participate in meetings and conferences, sharing relevant insights on student learning and providing translation or language support, when needed.  Student Care and Learning Environment  Help establish and maintain a positive, proactive, and fair classroom environment that promotes respect and self-management.  Supervise and support students to ensure safety and engagement during class and non-class times (breaks, lunch, transitions, etc.).  Apply logical and natural consequences in alignment with teacher expectations and school guidelines.  Communicate concerns about student well-being or behavior to the classroom teacher promptly and appropriately.  Operational and School Support  Assist in daily classroom routines including attendance, organization, and resource management.  Provide administrative support such as photocopying, filing, and preparing materials.  Request, organize, distribute materials and resources for the classroom or department as needed.  Supervise students during assigned duties (e.g., car pickup, lunch, recess) and assist during school trips and events.  Substitute for the classroom teacher as needed and ensure continuity of learning and care.  Support translation and communication between school and families when necessary, ensuring the teacher remains the primary point of contact.  Support and guide new Teaching Assistants as needed.  Professional Conduct and Growth  Model professionalism, punctuality, confidentiality, and responsible communication, including social media conduct.  Follow EAC policies, procedures, and safeguarding expectations as outlined in the Faculty/Staff Handbook.  Engage in professional development opportunities and participate in the Teaching Assistant Professional Growth and Evaluation process.  Collaborate positively with colleagues, offering support to new teaching assistants and contributing to a culture of collegiality and continuous improvement.  Additional Responsibilities  Engages in regular meetings and professional learning as part of the school’s commitment to continuous growth and collaboration.  Engage in the behavioral norms and expectations of the school.  Support student toileting needs, as per school norms, as assigned.  Follow the EAC Safeguarding Guide.  Working Conditions  Walk on paths and rough terrain  Lifting backpacks and school materials  Other duties, as assigned.  POSITION REQUIREMENTS:  Degree in Pedagogy, preferred  Five years experience working with children, preferred  PYP and inquiry-based teaching and learning experience (preferred) English level required: B2 or above  Portuguese level required: B2 or above  Other Skills (Desirable):  Proven capacity to build relationships of trust and respect  Proven capacity and confidence working within a collaborative, team-oriented environment  Strong written, verbal, and digital communication skills  Strong professional organization skills  Child Safeguarding  Our school is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and have developed and adopted written guidelines (Code of Conduct) for appropriate and inappropriate behavior of adults towards children.  We expect all staff, volunteers and other third parties to share this commitment and to review and affirm that they have read, understood, and will abide by the Code of Conduct.  At our school, we use safer recruitment practice and pre-employment background checks, to maintain the highest standards of safeguarding and child safety.  EAC’s Statement of Diversity and Inclusion  EAC embodies inclusion and diversity. As a community, we embrace the truth that diversity enriches us as individuals and as a community. Diversity includes recognizing individual differences in relation to cultural backgrounds, age, abilities, religious beliefs, gender and gender expression, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, religious beliefs, political beliefs, or other ideologies. The multiplicity of backgrounds and perspectives within our community reflect the entire world. Thus, we work to ensure that all members of our community enjoy mutual respect, are valued for who they are, and share a sense of belonging.

title: Pessoa consultora comercial profissionalizantes - anhanguera campinas ouro verde
description: Somos o grupo educacional mais diversificado do país. Todos os dias, criamos futuros incríveis através da inovação. Colocamos a mão na massa para tirar as ideias do papel e colocá-las em prática. Enfrentamos desafios com resiliência e nos adaptamos às mudanças constantes.  Por aqui, somos um time e não heróis, guiados pela vontade de fazer a diferença e conectados de um só jeito, o #Jeito Cogna. Nossa relação é direta e respeitosa, e o sucesso dos nossos alunos e clientes é o nosso sucesso.  Além disso, valorizamos a diversidade, porque sabemos que quanto mais diverso é o nosso repertório, mais abrangente e inclusivo seremos. Juntos impulsionamos as pessoas a construírem uma melhor versão de si! E aí, bora fazer parte da empresa líder absoluta do segmento educacional? Vem pra Cogna. Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.  Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia. title: Security Engineer
description:
Overview

Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you! Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Our team is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds with a shared conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy. Ledn values integrity, accountability, progress, and empathy. We are remote-friendly and operate globally.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full-time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Responsibilities
  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads using AWS Nitro Enclaves; integrate with KMS and secure APIs; migrate high-value operations into enclave environments; ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience.
  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.
What You Bring To Ledn
  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review and understanding of software supply chain.
  • Strong Linux internals knowledge and ability to remediate vulnerabilities identified in penetration tests.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.
Nice To Haves
  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.
Culture Fit
  • We’re looking for a leader who thrives in a startup or tech environment and embodies our values: integrity, progress, empathy.
The Ideal Candidate Will
  • Have a passion for progress, be adaptable and resilient, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.
What We Provide
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package, including generous PTO and ownership in the company through equity.
  • Remote work options up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A purpose-driven career and a remote-first, globally distributed team.
  • Commitment to equal opportunity and inclusivity; accommodation requests are welcome and confidential.

Please note, due to high volume of applications, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Shortlisted candidates may be asked to submit a short video response and we may review publicly available social media activity relevant to the role. No agencies or recruiters please. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and we are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Seu papel é transformar cada visita à loja em uma jornada sensorial e emocional, promovendo um atendimento consultivo e autêntico.

  • Garantir a organização da loja, em geral.
  • Gerenciar com a equipe a reposição de produtos no salão de vendas;

  • Ministrar treinamentos teóricos e práticos;

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Cosmetologia, Estética ou áreas afins;

É muita história para contar...

Desde o século XIX a Granado atravessa gerações encantando seus consumidores com produtos de qualidade e com uma pegada sustentável. São mais de 150 anos e, desde sua fundação, a marca sempre soube manter valores sólidos e estar atenta às necessidades de seu tempo. Cresceu e rejuvenesceu sem perder a essência.

Em 1930, a Perfumaria Phebo foi fundada em Belém do Pará, com fragrâncias marcantes, originais e de alta qualidade. Esta tradição, aliada ao seu conhecimento, ousadia e personalidade forte, alçou a Phebo ao topo das marcas de cosméticos mais respeitadas do mercado brasileiro, tornando-se sinônimo de luxo, excelência olfativa e qualidade.

Com uma proposta que valoriza o equilíbrio e o consumo consciente, recentemente a CARE se uniu à Granado e à Phebo para oferecer uma experiência de autocuidado transformadora, integrando ciência, tecnologia e sustentabilidade.

Nossa rica história centenária ajuda a construir um futuro inovador. Estamos presentes em cada produto desenvolvido; em cada loja inaugurada no Brasil e no exterior; em cada embalagem diferenciada e em cada olhar comprometido com o bem-estar das pessoas, com a segurança no local de trabalho e com a preservação do meio ambiente.

Juntas, Granado, Phebo e CARE representam a harmonia entre história e futuro, tradição e renovação, convidando seus consumidores a viverem jornadas únicas de bem-estar e beleza responsável.

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com área Administrativa nos assuntos pertinentes a sua área.
  • Elaborar os procedimentos pertinentes a sua área de atuação, tais como: plano de atendimento emergencial, trabalho em altura, permissão de trabalho, análise de risco do trabalho, entre outros, a fim de permitir uma melhor condição de segurança na Empresa.

Job description

Para atuar no grupo de Biossegurança (BIOS) do Centro Nacional de Pesquisa em Energia e Materiais (CNPEM).

A área de Biossegurança, é responsável por garantir que as atividades em laboratórios de alta e máxima contenção sejam conduzidas com o mais alto padrão de segurança biológica, protegendo pessoas, o meio ambiente e as pesquisas desenvolvidas.

Com atuação estratégica e técnica, a área promove treinamentos especializados, realiza simulados de emergência, elabora políticas e procedimentos, e implementa práticas alinhadas às normas nacionais e internacionais. Também participa ativamente da discussão de normas técnicas e da articulação com instituições nacionais e internacionais, promovendo o intercâmbio de conhecimento e boas práticas.

Main responsibilities
  • Assegura que todas as operações do laboratório estejam em conformidade com as normas e regulamentações de biossegurança locais, nacionais e internacionais;
  • Garante que todos os profissionais recebam treinamento adequado em biossegurança, com foco no manuseio seguro de agentes biológicos e no uso correto de Equipamentos de Proteção Individual (EPIs) em ambientes NB3;
  • Supervisiona as discussões e práticas envolvendo manipulação de materiais biológicos, garantindo conformidade com as boas práticas NB3;
  • Desenvolve, implanta e mantém Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POPs) para o laboratório NB3, assegurando sua correta aplicação pelas equipes envolvidas;
  • Realiza inspeções para identificar e corrigir não conformidades, além de preparar o laboratório para auditorias e certificações;
  • Mantém registros completos e atualizados de todas as atividades relacionadas à biossegurança, como treinamentos, avaliações de risco, procedimentos, auditorias, inspeções e incidentes;
  • Promove a comunicação e colaboração eficaz entre diferentes departamentos e equipes para garantir abordagem integrada e coordenada à biossegurança no laboratório NB3;
  • Oferece suporte em discussões sobre biossegurança NB3;
  • Participa ativamente de comitês e grupos de trabalho relacionados à biossegurança e outras áreas relevantes, contribuindo com conhecimento técnico, orientações e soluções práticas.
Requirements and skills
  • Ensino Superior Completo na área de Ciências Biológicas (Biomedicina, Biologia, Veterinária, Enfermagem, Medicina ou correlatas);
  • Mestrado ou Doutorado Completo na área de Ciências Biológicas;
  • Inglês Avançado;
  • Ampla experiência prática laboratorial em biossegurança, com realização prévia de projetos científicos realizados em laboratório NB3 na área da microbiologia;
  • Experiência em lecionar aulas, palestras e/ou treinamentos;
  • Conhecimento teórico e prático dos princípios, boas práticas laboratoriais, equipamentos de proteção individual (EPIs) e procedimentos dos diferentes níveis de biossegurança microbiológica, em especial ao NB3;
  • Sólido conhecimento em regulamentações nacionais e internacionais em biossegurança;
  • Disponibilidade para realização viagens nacionais e/ou internacionais;
  • Disponibilidade para realização de cursos e treinamentos, nacionais e/ou internacionais (discente).

CPFL Comercial Brasil

O seu dia a dia

  • Realizar as previsões de clima e vento para geração eólica, a partir de modelos de tempo para até 15 dias (GFS, ECMWF) ou modelos de clima até 9 meses (CFSv2, WRF);
  • Desenvolver automações e melhorias em modelos e métodos de previsão climática e previsão de vento usando modelos dinâmicos globais e regionais, associados a métodos de machine learning para aprimoramento (acurácia) da previsão de vento para parque eólicos, ENA para usinas hidrelétricas de grande porte, possibilitando projeções de curto a longo prazo;
  • Participar de estudos técnicos para estender histórico de vento de torres anemométricas de parques em operação, usando dados de reanálise e outros métodos apropriados;
  • Criar indicadores e métodos de cálculo de acurácia de previsões de clima e vento e colaborar com demais áreas nas análises de desvios de geração ou previsão;
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para a melhoria contínua dos processos e ferramentas da área.

  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social e fonoaudiólogo).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços. Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento. Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

description:
OPERADOR LOGISTICA IN COMPANY (SÃO JOSÉ DOS PINHAIS/PR)

Localização: Campinas, SP, BR,

A Nortel é uma empresa do grupo Sonepar. Desde 1966 é referência no setor de MRO (manutenção, reparação e operação), com filiais espalhadas em todo território nacional.

Acreditamos que o segredo do nosso sucesso está na valorização de um ambiente de trabalho sensacional, que impulsiona nossa gente a buscar sempre a superação de seus objetivos pessoais e profissionais. Trabalhar na Nortel é fazer parte de uma empresa dinâmica, que reconhece seus talentos e incentiva você a buscar sempre o seu melhor. Pioneira no segmento, a Nortel tem como principal objetivo Simplificar a Vida de Seus Clientes, diferenciando-se das demais empresas em seu catálogo de produtos e serviços, buscando sempre a excelência e a atenção às necessidades de seus clientes.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Separar ou armazenar materiais com qualidade e assertividade, seguindo os processos corretamente, para garantir a acuracidade do estoque.
  • Realizar a sugestão de indicações de ajustes de inventário/estoque forçado através de comunicação com a liderança para manter o correto abastecimento
  • Fazer o armazenamento e a estocagem de materiais utilizando a metodologia PEPS ou FIFO (Primeiro que Entra, Primeiro que Sai) ou (First In, First Out) para correta gestão do estoque
  • Realizar o controle e Inventário do Certificado de Aprovação de EPI's e FISPQ (Ficha de Inspeção de Produto Químico) através das informações recebidas pelo fabricante para correta gestão do estoque
  • Fazer a gestão e abastecimento das Vending Machines realizando seu abastecimento e inventários a fim de garantir seu correto funcionamento
  • Separar pedidos e Requisições de Materiais através da solicitação do cliente para entrega de produtos ao cliente.
  • Extrair relatórios do Allianza através de informações extraídas do sistema para envio ao cliente, medição do estoque das vending machines/lojas
  • Viajar ocasionalmente quando solicitado para outras unidades do grupo para efetuar suporte operacional, conforme programação necessária instruída pelo Gestor imediato, para atender uma demanda específica e sazonal.
  • Movimentar volumes na área de conferência e expedição para transporte, usando os carrinhos de movimentação a triagem dos volumes para os Stages de expedição, e garantir a disponibilidade de volumes para expedição/transporte.
  • Organizar e manter limpeza do departamento utilizando o conceito 5S. para manter o ambiente limpo e organizado.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em São José dos Pinhais/PR
  • Experiência com Logística será um diferencial

Benefícios:
Assistência Médica, Assistência Odontológica, Refeição, Vale transporte, Seguro de Vida, Gympass, PLR, Acesso a Plataforma de Idiomas GoFluent.

Programa de Apoio Optum: Em parceria com a Ifood , para orientação psicológica e social extensivo aos familiares, sem custo ao Colaborador, com acesso mediante contato telefônico;

Todos os candidatos qualificados serão avaliados para oportunidades de emprego com base em seus méritos, sem discriminação por motivo de raça, cor, religião, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, origem nacional ou deficiência.

title: Dentista Avaliador | Campinas - Flamboyant | (Banco de Talentos)
description:
Overview

DESCRIÇÃO
DENTISTA Avaliador(a) (Banco de Talentos). Você é dentista, ama cuidar de pessoas, e gosta de metas, desafios e resultados? Transforme sorrisos e resultados conosco. Na Odontoclinic, buscamos Dentistas Avaliadores(as) com olhar clínico e espírito comercial, que encantem no atendimento e entreguem experiências únicas para o paciente.

O Que Você Vai Encontrar Aqui

  • Um ambiente acolhedor, colaborativo e com alto astral
  • Treinamentos constantes e ferramentas para o seu desenvolvimento
  • Reconhecimento por desempenho e oportunidades reais de crescimento
  • Remuneração atrativa com base em meritocracia
  • Propósito: transformar a vida das pessoas através do sorriso

Procuramos Alguém Com

  • Formação em Odontologia com CRO ativo
  • Comunicação empática, segura e persuasiva
  • Facilidade para construir conexão e gerar confiança com o paciente
  • Capacidade de apresentar planos de tratamento de forma clara e estratégica
  • Energia, foco em metas e atitude de dono(a)
  • Vivência com vendas será um diferencial, mas vontade de aprender conta muito

Suas Principais Missões

  • Realizar avaliações iniciais com excelência e atenção genuína
  • Apresentar planos de tratamento alinhados às necessidades do paciente
  • Trabalhar de forma próxima com a equipe para atingir metas e gerar encantamento
  • Ser um elo entre o cuidado clínico e o sucesso do paciente na jornada odontológica

Se você acredita que excelência clínica e performance podem andar juntas, essa é a sua chance de fazer parte de algo grandioso. Vem ser Odontocliniquer e crescer com a gente!

Sobre a ODONTOCLINIC

Na Odontoclinic, somos movidos por pessoas e por sorrisos. Somos uma empresa feita de gente que gosta de gente. Aqui, acreditamos no poder da atitude, da ação e da paixão por encantar. Nosso time é formado por profissionais que não apenas vestem a camisa, mas têm atitude de dono, colocam a mão na massa e fazem acontecer todos os dias.

Com mais de 28 anos de história, construímos a maior rede de franquias odontológicas do Brasil. São mais de 180 clínicas em todo o país, mais de 1 milhão de sorrisos cuidados com carinho e cerca de 9 mil atendimentos realizados por dia. Tudo isso é possível porque temos um time incrível por trás de cada resultado. Somos a primeira rede de franquias odontológicas do país e, ao longo dos anos, recebemos prêmios como o Troféu Excelência em Franchising da ABF e reconhecimentos como uma das Melhores Franquias do Brasil pela revista Pequenas Empresas & Grandes Negócios. Fomos eleitos, por seis anos consecutivos, como a clínica com o melhor atendimento do Brasil no segmento odontológico pelo Reclame Aqui.

Aqui, valorizamos o desenvolvimento de pessoas como caminho para resultados sustentáveis. Investimos em treinamentos, programas de capacitação e iniciativas que potencializam o crescimento pessoal e profissional. Acreditamos no poder da educação continuada como alicerce para inovação, performance e encantamento. Se você tem espírito empreendedor, gosta de desafios e quer fazer parte de algo grande, seu lugar é aqui. Vem ser Odontocliniquer!
